overview: The Medford Community Development Board endorsed a lot-line adjustment plan, approved a mixed-use site plan review for 255-257 Main Street, and continued site plan review public hearings for 360 Salem Street and 400 Riverside Avenue. The board also conducted a working discussion on proposed Medford Square zoning amendments and approved prior meeting minutes.

items.title: ANR Plan Endorsement for Bridle Path Lots 4 & 5
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) plan transferring 1,100 square feet from lot four to lot five within the Bridle Path subdivision.

items.title: Site Plan Review for 255-257 Main Street
items.summary: Approved the site plan review for an eight-unit condominium building with ground-floor commercial space, subject to conditions including tree replacement funding, twice-weekly trash collection, and economic development coordination.

items.title: Continued Site Plan Review for 360 Salem Street
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to March 4, 2026, requesting the applicant revise massing and parking concepts to address abutter shadow impacts, parking stacker concerns, and affordable unit preservation.

items.title: Site Plan Review for 400 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to February 18, 2026 to allow the applicant time to address department feedback on parking, accessibility, and fire department access for a proposed co-working and maker space retrofit.

items.title: Discussion on Medford Square Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Discussed feedback for upcoming zoning consultant sessions, emphasizing sub-district boundaries, accelerating development on city-owned parcels, standalone parking garage permissions, and historic preservation tools.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the board meeting minutes for October and November.
